magic.mushokutenseiorigin.book_page:
Zenith Greyrat's Magic Book

Water Ball
Water magic

Learn the chant to unlock this spell.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.natur:
Magic Primer

Magic uses mana to affect matter. Learn a formula, then control creation, size, speed and release. Check your reserves before casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.eleme:
Four Elements

Offensive magic uses water, fire, wind and earth. Water also includes ice and weather. This primer teaches one basic projectile per element.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ranks:
Ranks

Beginner, intermediate, advanced, saint, king, emperor and god rank describe formula difficulty, not overall combat ability. Master the basics first.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.metho:
Casting

Chants guide a formula. Shortened, omitted and silent forms also exist. Circles have other uses. Here, learning a chant unlocks instant casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.pract:
Practice

Load learned spells in Magic Knowledge. Select one with the wheel. Hold Cast to repeat. Each release costs mana and must wait for its cooldown.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.safet:
Safety

Rest when mana runs low. Successful sleep restores mana. Basic shots vanish on impact. Avoid allies. Combined and sustained magic require further study.

Fires a sequence of ice projectiles at its targets.
Launches a crescent-shaped blade of ice to cut through targets.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_f: Sends a wave forward along the ground to push targets away.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_i: Raises a temporary ice wall that can provide cover and support footing.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: Triggers an explosion at the targeted position.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_f: Raises a pillar of fire at the target to burn enemies.
Projects a wide cone of fire forward.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_w: Tears into a struck target with a high-speed wind blade.
Binds a target with wind, restricting its movement.
Releases a strong gust to propel the caster for movement or evasion.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: Raises an earth lance; its flat-topped form can also serve as a lift.
Drops a massive rock from above the target.
Uses intermediate healing magic for severe injuries; the source notes that major organ damage remains beyond it.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_a: An expanded intermediate detoxification spell for a wider range of poisons and illnesses.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_p: Creates a physical barrier that blocks physical attacks and prevents creatures from passing through.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.legacy_direct_: Legacy books teach any listed spell directly, without a chant score or prerequisite checks.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_b: Ice gravel and cold mist radiate for four seconds, dealing 2 damage every half second. Does not harm the caster.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_blizza: Radius 8; eight ice pulses over 4 seconds. Follows caster without self damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_squall: Local rain: radius 16, height 32, duration 45 seconds. Exposed creatures become wet for 15 seconds and are extinguished. Evaporating environments halve duration.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_s: Local rain: radius 16, height 32, duration 45 seconds. Exposed creatures become wet for 15 seconds and are extinguished. Evaporating environments halve duration.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_exodus: A three-block constant-speed fireball. Contact bursts have radius four; each target takes at most 18 fire damage per cast. Flies for nine seconds, pierces water and waterloggable incomplete blocks, and stops at solid walls. No TNT.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: A three-block constant-speed fireball. Contact bursts have radius four; each target takes at most 18 fire damage per cast. Flies for nine seconds, pierces water and waterloggable incomplete blocks, and stops at solid walls. No TNT.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_tornad: A 1.5-wide, 3-long wind drill flying at 3 blocks/tick for 9 seconds. Each target takes 16 damage once, with a forward impulse of 1.0 on successful damage. Water is passable; solid walls stop it.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_t: A 1.5-wide, 3-long wind drill flying at 3 blocks/tick for 9 seconds. Each target takes 16 damage once, with a forward impulse of 1.0 on successful damage. Water is passable; solid walls stop it.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_cumulo: A local raincloud of radius 24 and height 48 lasts 60 seconds. Lightning attempts every 2 seconds prefer exposed hostile creatures: 8 damage in radius 2, at most once per target every 4 seconds. Exposed creatures become wet for 20 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_c: A local raincloud of radius 24 and height 48 lasts 60 seconds. Lightning attempts every 2 seconds prefer exposed hostile creatures: 8 damage in radius 2, at most once per target every 4 seconds. Exposed creatures become wet for 20 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_lightn: Exposed point within 64 blocks; final 0.75-second locked warning. Radius 2, height 32: 32 damage. Binds creatures for 2 seconds or players for 1 second.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_l: Exposed point within 64 blocks; final 0.75-second locked warning. Radius 2, height 32: 32 damage. Binds creatures for 2 seconds or players for 1 second.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_electr: First visible target within 32 blocks: 10 damage. Binds creatures for 3 seconds or players for 2 seconds. Bosses receive Slowness II for 3 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: First visible target within 32 blocks: 10 damage. Binds creatures for 3 seconds or players for 2 seconds. Bosses receive Slowness II for 3 seconds.

magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_frost_: A radius-8 sphere deals 10 ice damage without harming its caster. Wet targets take 4 extra damage and lose wetness. Freeze for 15 seconds, bind creatures for 2 seconds or players for 1. Warmth blocks freeze and binding.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_f: A radius-8 sphere deals 10 ice damage without harming its caster. Wet targets take 4 extra damage and lose wetness. Freeze for 15 seconds, bind creatures for 2 seconds or players for 1. Warmth blocks freeze and binding.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_sonic_: A forward 16-block cone with a 35-degree half angle deals 12 damage and pushes outward by 1.2 velocity. Does not harm the caster; solid walls block the wave.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_s: A forward 16-block cone with a 35-degree half angle deals 12 damage and pushes outward by 1.2 velocity. Does not harm the caster; solid walls block the wave.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_earth_: Create a temporary 5 by 3 by 1 earth wall within 24 blocks for 60 seconds. Insufficient space cancels the entire cast without cost. Restores original blocks and drops no items.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: Create a temporary 5 by 3 by 1 earth wall within 24 blocks for 60 seconds. Insufficient space cancels the entire cast without cost. Restores original blocks and drops no items.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_earth_: A hollow temporary earth hemisphere, outer radius 4 and thickness 1, with a two-block-high doorway. Lasts 120 seconds, at most 200 blocks, avoiding creatures and existing solid terrain.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: A hollow temporary earth hemisphere, outer radius 4 and thickness 1, with a two-block-high doorway. Lasts 120 seconds, at most 200 blocks, avoiding creatures and existing solid terrain.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_earth_: Twelve 1×3×1 earth spires rise every 2 ticks within radius 6, selected on ground up to 32 blocks away. Lasts 20 seconds; 6 damage per cluster, at most two clusters per target.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_e: Twelve 1×3×1 earth spires rise every 2 ticks within radius 6, selected on ground up to 32 blocks away. Lasts 20 seconds; 6 damage per cluster, at most two clusters per target.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.category_intro: A radius-6 mire on ground up to 32 blocks away, lasting 20 seconds. Slowness III and reduced jumping; bosses receive only Slowness I. No direct damage or real fluid.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_quagmi: A radius-6 mire on ground up to 32 blocks away, lasting 20 seconds. Slowness III and reduced jumping; bosses receive only Slowness I. No direct damage or real fluid.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_q: A radius-6 mire on ground up to 32 blocks away, lasting 20 seconds. Slowness III and reduced jumping; bosses receive only Slowness I. No direct damage or real fluid.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_blast: A 10-block hot wind cone, half angle 30 degrees: 4 fire damage and 0.6 outward impulse. No self damage, ignition or terrain damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_b: A 10-block hot wind cone, half angle 30 degrees: 4 fire damage and 0.6 outward impulse. No self damage, ignition or terrain damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_bora_b: A 20-block cold cone: 8 ice damage, 0.7 outward impulse and 15 seconds freezing. Wet targets receive Slowness II for 5 seconds; warmth is consumed to prevent freezing.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_b: A 20-block cold cone: 8 ice damage, 0.7 outward impulse and 15 seconds freezing. Wet targets receive Slowness II for 5 seconds; warmth is consumed to prevent freezing.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_magma_: A radius-4, height-5 eruption up to 32 blocks away: 10 initial damage, then 2 fire damage at seconds 1 through 8. No bucketable lava; at most 64 temporary heated surface cells, restored on expiry.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_m: A radius-4, height-5 eruption up to 32 blocks away: 10 initial damage, then 2 fire damage at seconds 1 through 8. No bucketable lava; at most 64 temporary heated surface cells, restored on expiry.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_violen: A radius-16, height-16 wind field lasting 20 seconds. Deals 2 damage and pushes outward by 0.2 each second; excludes the caster. Shortens overlapping local weather.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_v: A radius-16, height-16 wind field lasting 20 seconds. Deals 2 damage and pushes outward by 0.2 each second; excludes the caster. Shortens overlapping local weather.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_tornad: A radius-5, height-20 vortex moving forward at 2 blocks per second for 15 seconds. Deals 4 damage each second, pulling inward by 0.12 and upward by 0.08. Does not lift blocks or dropped items.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_t: A radius-5, height-20 vortex moving forward at 2 blocks per second for 15 seconds. Deals 4 damage each second, pulling inward by 0.12 and upward by 0.08. Does not lift blocks or dropped items.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_vacuum: A radius-12, height-12 cutting wind field lasting 15 seconds. Deals 6 damage each second and applies Slowness I for 25 seconds. Solid walls block its effects.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_v: A radius-12, height-12 cutting wind field lasting 15 seconds. Deals 6 damage each second and applies Slowness I for 25 seconds. Solid walls block its effects.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_sky_te: A radius-24, height-40 storm lasting 30 seconds. Deals 4 damage each second, or 7 within the central radius of 8. Applies rotating and rising impulses; player upward velocity is capped at 0.35.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_s: A radius-24, height-40 storm lasting 30 seconds. Deals 4 damage each second, or 7 within the central radius of 8. Applies rotating and rising impulses; player upward velocity is capped at 0.35.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_flash_: A radius-16, height-6 flash up to 48 blocks away deals 16 fire damage. The field lasts 8 seconds and attempts 3 fire damage each second, subject to vanilla hurt immunity. Includes the caster; solid walls block damage; no spreading fire.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_f: A radius-16, height-6 flash up to 48 blocks away deals 16 fire damage. The field lasts 8 seconds and attempts 3 fire damage each second, subject to vanilla hurt immunity. Includes the caster; solid walls block damage; no spreading fire.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_flame_: A radius-5, height-18 burning vortex up to 32 blocks away moves at 2 blocks per second for 12 seconds. Deals 7 fire damage each second, pulls inward by 0.12 and upward by 0.06. Bosses resist displacement; player upward velocity is capped at 0.35.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_f: A radius-5, height-18 burning vortex up to 32 blocks away moves at 2 blocks per second for 12 seconds. Deals 7 fire damage each second, pulls inward by 0.12 and upward by 0.06. Bosses resist displacement; player upward velocity is capped at 0.35.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_infern: A radius-20, height-8 field up to 64 blocks away. Deals 18 initial fire damage and attempts 5 each second from second 1 through 20. Includes the caster; solid walls block damage. Up to 2048 permitted surface cells temporarily become scorched and are restored on expiry.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_i: A radius-20, height-8 field up to 64 blocks away. Deals 18 initial fire damage and attempts 5 each second from second 1 through 20. Includes the caster; solid walls block damage. Up to 2048 permitted surface cells temporarily become scorched and are restored on expiry.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_absolu: A radius-16 sphere up to 48 blocks away deals 28 ice damage, plus 6 against wet targets and consumes wetness. Freezes for 30 seconds and binds creatures for 3 seconds or players for 2. Consumes warmth to block control. Eight seconds of cold mist refreshes normal freezing without direct damage. Up to 4096 surface water cells freeze temporarily for 60 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.lesson_intro_a: A radius-16 sphere up to 48 blocks away deals 28 ice damage, plus 6 against wet targets and consumes wetness. Freezes for 30 seconds and binds creatures for 3 seconds or players for 2. Consumes warmth to block control. Eight seconds of cold mist refreshes normal freezing without direct damage. Up to 4096 surface water cells freeze temporarily for 60 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.category_intro: Special magic uses separate casting timings. Timing tiers are not official ranks.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.forecast_proje: Existing projectile may pose a threat in roughly %s seconds
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.forecast_cast: A hostile cast has already started nearby
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.category_intro: Temporary UUID-bound summons require mana upkeep. Use /mtsummon follow|stay|attack|protect|stop.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.communication_: Draft ready for 60 seconds. Select Communication Magic and cast normally to send.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.teleport_invit: %s invites you to teleport. Accept within 60 seconds with /mtteleport accept <caster>; decline revokes consent.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.teleport_inval: Circle, consent, loaded destination or safe arrival space is invalid.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.combo_ready: Combo ready. Hold cast to chant Ice Lance, then Blizzard normally. Release or interruption cancels.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_ocean_: A water-surface wave expands at 8 blocks/s to radius 64, freezing up to three layers and 8192 water cells for 600 seconds. Each target takes 20 ice damage once and freezes for 35 seconds. Cracking particles warn during the last 10 seconds. No water is created.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_flame_: A 16-wide, 8-high, 4-deep fire wall travels at 2 blocks/s for 12 seconds. Contact attempts 6 fire damage each second, at most six hits per target. Ignites for 25 seconds. Solid walls block each affected section.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_apocal: A radius-48, height-24 field up to 96 blocks away warns for 3 seconds, deals 48 fire damage once, then attempts 4 fire damage each second for 15 seconds. The caster is not exempt. Permanent terrain damage is opt-in and capped at 8192 surface cells.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_atmosp: 1600 MP plus 30 MP/s. A moving radius-48, height-64 field lasts up to 60 seconds. Shift+V selects calm, directional wind, or storm before casting. Calm shortens local weather; wind applies a 0.2 impulse; storm attempts 6 damage/s. Does not change global weather.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_dust_s: A radius-10, height-8 field up to 32 blocks away lasts 20 seconds. Reduces visibility and new hostile targeting range to 12 blocks, applying Slowness I except to bosses. No direct damage. Vision recovers over 2 seconds after leaving.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_sandst: A radius-20, height-16 field up to 48 blocks away lasts 30 seconds. Attempts 2 damage/s, limits visibility to 8 blocks and applies Slowness II. Solid walls block exposure; no extra suffocation damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_earthq: A radius-16 ground shock up to 48 blocks away deals 14 damage once and applies an upward 0.45 impulse to targets within 2 blocks of the surface. Binds creatures for 1.5 seconds or players for 0.75. Optional permanent excavation is capped at 512 cells and two layers.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_terra_: Three rock waves strike a radius-20, height-12 field up to 64 blocks away, two seconds apart with a one-second warning. Each wave attempts 10 damage per target. Applies Slowness III for 5 seconds after the waves. Up to 2048 temporary debris cells last 90 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_contin: A radius-48 ground disk up to 96 blocks away deals 36 damage once and pulls inward with a 0.5 impulse. Subsidence visuals and Slowness III last 10 seconds. Optional excavation is limited to four surface layers and 8192 cells.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_sand_c: A sand projectile starts at 1.5 blocks/tick with 0.05 gravity. Impact creates a radius-4, height-4 dust cloud for 6 seconds, limiting visibility to 6 blocks without damage. Does not pierce creatures or water.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_deep_m: A radius-12, height-8 mist field up to 32 blocks away lasts 30 seconds. Limits vision and new hostile targeting range to 6 blocks, with a half-second transition. Solid walls block exposure. Warmth does not remove this mist.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_mud_ra: A radius-14, height-24 local rain field up to 48 blocks away lasts 25 seconds. Exposed targets receive Slowness II and halved jump height, refreshed each second for 3 seconds. No direct damage or real mud blocks.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_nuclea: Choose 3000-6000 total MP using /mtnuclear extra_mp. Requires a 90-second ritual and a valid circle. After a 5-second warning, deals 60-80 damage once in a radius-24-32 sphere. Includes the caster, respects walls, and has a 300-second reuse interval. No radiation system.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_antido: For 28 MP, removes Poison, Nausea, Hunger and Weakness from a consenting visible ally within 12 blocks, or the caster while sneaking. No valid removable effect means no charge. Does not cure Wither or introduce diseases.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_exorci: For 6 MP, hits the first visible undead or tagged spirit within 24 blocks for 6 holy damage. Does not harm players or ordinary living creatures and cannot pass through walls.
For 14 MP, deals 8 holy damage to undead in a radius-4 sphere centered up to 24 blocks away. Uses the intermediate half-second recovery time.
For 34 MP, deals 20 holy damage to one visible undead within 40 blocks. Ordinary living creatures and players are excluded.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_holy_r: For 100 MP, deals 24 holy damage once per undead in a forward cylinder 32 blocks long and 2 blocks in radius. Solid walls cut the beam short.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_sacred: For 240 MP, deals 32 holy damage and a 0.6 outward impulse to undead in a radius-16 sphere around the caster. A 5-second light field blocks ordinary natural undead spawning; it does not delete existing mobs.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_divine: For 560 MP, a radius-12, height-32 light column up to 64 blocks away attempts three 18-damage holy pulses one second apart. Each target is hit at most once per pulse. Bosses receive normal damage, not an instant kill.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_god_pu: For 1800 MP, deals 72 holy damage once to undead in a radius-48 sphere up to 96 blocks away. Blocks natural undead spawning for 30 seconds, without canceling commands or spawners.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_dual_s: For 42 MP, creates a fixed 4-by-4 barrier for 20 seconds. Physical and magical capacity are 24 each, with only the selected defense active. Shift+V selects physical or magical defense before casting; rebuilding costs MP again.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_spirit: For 120 MP, creates a radius-8 sphere within 32 blocks for 60 seconds with 100 capacity. Only undead and tagged spirits are blocked in both directions. Living creatures can cross freely; attacks on the shell consume capacity.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_confin: For 280 MP, surrounds a non-boss target within 24 blocks with a radius-3 sphere and 160 capacity. Blocks movement, attacks across the shell and starting magic inside. Lasts 20 seconds for creatures or 5 for players. Bosses receive 5 seconds of Slowness I instead.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_fortre: 600 MP plus 10 stored core MP/s. A fixed radius-24 hemisphere has 600 shared capacity, regenerates 8 capacity/s and lasts at most 300 seconds. Allies can cross. The core is destructible; loss of power dissolves the field after 5 seconds.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_demon_: Requires five powered cores in a radius-12 pentagon and a tagged non-player target at or below 20% health. A 90-second ritual costs 2400 MP plus 400 energy per core. The seal has 1200 capacity and lasts 600 seconds; destroying any core releases the target.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_illusi: 100 MP plus 2 MP/s. A fixed radius-12, height-12 projection lasts at most 120 seconds. External viewers see sampled local terrain and hidden non-allied contents. Insiders, spectators and administrators see through it. Does not block sound, movement or damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_monste: 50 MP plus 1 MP/s. Summons one temporary beast for 60 seconds: 24 health, 4 melee damage, one attack/s. Use /mtsummon follow, stay, attack or dismiss. No inventory, loot, experience or breeding.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_spirit: 120 MP plus 2 MP/s. Summons one spirit for 90 seconds: 30 health and one 5-damage attack/s. Follow, stay, attack and protect commands are available. Nearby protect mode reduces magical damage by 15%; total mod damage reduction is capped at 60%.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_lampli: 8 MP plus 1 MP per 5 seconds. Three small warm lights orbit one invisible carrier for up to 300 seconds. Temporary light cells follow safe loaded positions and are restored. The carrier cannot be damaged, traded with or used as storage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_distur: For 50 MP, interrupts one unfinished mod spell within 24 blocks. Cast time is 0.4 seconds; recovery is 8 seconds even on failure. The interrupted slot cannot restart for 1.5 seconds. Does not delete launched projectiles, established fields or divine ritual cores.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_howlin: For 18 MP, a 12-block, 50-degree sound cone deals 4 damage and briefly unbalances non-boss targets. A radius-16 echo shows a vague source direction for 2 seconds, without player names or exact coordinates. Solid walls block damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_telepo: A 30-second chant links two registered circles. Costs 160 MP plus 2 per started 16 blocks in the same dimension, or an additional 400 for a whitelisted dimension transfer. Takes the caster and up to three consenting players or owned pets within 2 blocks. Requires loaded safe arrivals; riders and loose items are rejected.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_gravit: 120 MP plus 8 MP/s. A radius-6, height-12 field up to 32 blocks away lasts at most 20 seconds. Shift+V selects heavy gravity (2 damage/s, Slowness II, reduced jumping) or light gravity (0.03 upward impulse and Slow Falling). Bosses resist forced movement.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_divina: For 40 MP, inspect yourself or a consenting player within 8 blocks using a crystal. Reports uncertain trends over the next 10 seconds from existing projectiles, fall trajectories and hostile casting. Timing varies by up to 2 seconds. Does not reveal seeds, loot or unexplored structures.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_saint_: 240 MP plus 12 MP/s. Activates in 2 seconds and lasts at most 20 seconds. Reduces post-armor damage by 35% and adds 0.5 knockback resistance. Combined mod reduction is capped at 60%. Electric bypasses this aura; administrative damage is excluded. Cooldown is 30 seconds after ending.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_hypnos: For 30 MP, puts one visible non-boss within 16 blocks to sleep for 8 seconds, or a player for 2 seconds. Any damage wakes the target. After waking, the target is immune to hypnosis for 10 seconds. Does not skip night or restore MP.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_commun: For 4 MP, sends up to 120 characters to one online mutually bound player, across dimensions. Prepare with /mtcommunication draft. Cast time is 1 second and recovery 2 seconds. Recipients can mute or unbind; offline delivery fails without charging. Uses normal signed and filtered chat.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.summary_necrom: 180 MP plus 2 MP/s shared upkeep. Consumes a nearby non-player ordinary corpse record to summon one temporary undead, up to two at once. Each has 20 health, 4 melee damage and one attack/s for 60 seconds. No copied inventory, loot or experience. Holy damage affects them.
